1.name: Pistol
1.description: Light semi-auto sidearm. Reloads when the magazine is empty.
1.lmbDescription: Fire one accurate shot per click.

2.name: Shock Blaster
2.description: Energy rifle with a hitscan beam and a slow plasma orb.
2.lmbDescription: Instant energy beam out to long range.
2.comboDescription: Hit your orb with LMB before it lands for a much bigger blast.

3.name: Rocket Launcher
3.description: Six rockets in a rotating magazine. Heavy splash damage.
3.lmbDescription: Fire one rocket from the next barrel.
3.rmbDescription: Hold to mark rockets, release to fire them all at once.

4.name: Ripper
4.description: Ricocheting discs that bounce off walls and floors.
4.lmbDescription: Small fast disk. Bounces up to five times.
4.rmbDescription: Larger disk. Costs two ammo per shot.

5.name: Flak Cannon
5.lmbDescription: Six pellets in a tight spread. Lethal splash on hit.
5.rmbDescription: Lob a grenade. It splits into four shrapnel on impact.

6.name: Sniper Rifle
6.description: Slow, high-damage shots. Small magazine, long reload.
6.rmbDescription: Hold to zoom in. Does not fire.

7.name: Gatling
7.description: Full-auto bullet hose. Burns through a large magazine fast.
7.lmbDescription: Hold to spray with tight spread.
7.rmbDescription: Hold to spray with wider spread.

8.name: Pulse Lance
8.description: Plasma bolts and a short melt beam. Beam overheats if held too long.
8.rmbDescription: Hold for a close-range beam until it overheats.

9.name: Bio Lobber
9.description: Sticky bio globs. Charge a bigger blob at the muzzle.
9.lmbDescription: Toss small arcing clumps that stick on impact.
9.rmbDescription: Hold to grow a blob at the muzzle, release to throw it.

0.name: Redeemer Seed
0.description: One shot per reload. Massive expanding kill zone. Friendly fire included.
0.lmbDescription: Fire a slow nuke straight ahead.
0.rmbDescription: Launch a guided nuke. Camera follows; steer with the mouse.
